desc:
GLUTEN FREE: Double chocolate chip granola bars are a delicious gluten free snack for kids of all ages

MADE WITH GOODNESS: No artificial flavors, synthetic colors, and without high fructose corn syrup; Chewy granola bars are a perfect pantry staple, made with real chocolate chips

WHOLESOME ANNIE'S SNACKS: Each kids granola bar is Non-GMO Project Verified with 11g of whole grains per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

ON THE GO TREAT: Individually wrapped gluten free granola bars for lunchboxes and snacks on the go

CONTAINS: One regular cardboard carton of Annie's Gluten Free Chewy Granola Bars, Double Chocolate Chip, 5 Bars, 4.9 oz; Perfect for instant snacking
features:
Features

Gluten-Free Certified – Safe for individuals with celiac disease or gluten sensitivities.

Made with Whole Grain Oats – Contains around 8–11g of whole grains per serving.

Real Chocolate Chips – Uses real semi-sweet chocolate chips for a rich flavor.

Non-GMO Ingredients – Made without genetically modified organisms.

No Artificial Flavors or Colors – Free from synthetic additives.

No High-Fructose Corn Syrup – Sweetened naturally for a cleaner snack.

Individually Wrapped – Convenient and portable for lunchboxes, work, or on-the-go.

Low Sodium – Around 35–40mg per bar, suitable for low-salt diets.

Moderate Calories – Each bar contains approximately 110–120 calories.

Good Source of Fiber – Offers 1–3g of dietary fiber per bar.

Benefits

Tasty Gluten-Free Snacking – Offers a chewy, chocolatey treat without gluten, ideal for dietary restrictions.

Portable and Mess-Free – Easy to carry and perfect for school, work, or travel

Health-Conscious Option – Contains no artificial ingredients or HFCS, appealing to clean-eating lifestyles.

Kid-Friendly – Loved by children for its soft texture and chocolate taste.

Portion Controlled – Individually wrapped bars help with mindful snacking.

Heart-Healthy Grains – Whole grains contribute to overall health and digestion.

Balanced Sweetness – Sweet without being overly sugary, with around 7–8g of sugar per bar.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats*, Tapioca Syrup*, Cane Sugar*, Palm Oil*, Brown Rice*, Water, Semisweet Chocolate Chips* (cane sugar*, unsweetened chocolate*, cocoa butter*, vanilla powder*), Cocoa Powder* (processed with alkali), Brown Rice Syrup*, Grape Juice Concentrate*, Natural Flavor*, Agar, Sea Salt, Sunflower Lecithin*. *Organic
